topics.evidence: Identity, scope, users, value, boundaries and gated future capabilities are explicit.
Repository areas and their responsibilities are mapped.
Current deployed path, target MCP Apps design and assumptions are separated.
Prerequisites and reproducible local commands are documented, including the 401 blocker.
Implemented, planned, blocked and decision-gated states are distinguished.
The Linear tracker is authoritative and ACT-140 through ACT-154 are mapped. Its title Lena was rejected on 5 October 2026.
Stable decisions and unresolved approval gates are explicit.
Confirmed facts, blockers, boundaries and next actions are recorded.
Canonical sources, update triggers and verification rules are defined.
Current, historical and superseded sources are indexed with status.
Trigger, before/after state, boundary and verification limits are recorded.
Local checks and acceptance criteria are documented; unexecuted live checks are not claimed as passed.
Current and planned MCP tool contracts, transport and UI boundaries are documented.
PII, authentication, tenant, SQL and high-risk capability requirements are explicit.
Hosting, deployment boundary, observability gaps and no-deploy status are documented.
The historical DOCX is identified as stale and future data exports are decision-gated in ACT-152.
Local evidence and current external primary guidance are listed with verification limits.
